text: Human Rights Watch reports that in 2026 Bahraini authorities arbitrarily arrested dozens of people for exercising their right to freedom of expression, that Mohammed Almosawi died in custody after being forcibly disappeared for more than a week with signs of torture on his body, and that authorities stripped 67 people of citizenship; human rights defenders and political leaders including Abdulhadi al-Khawaja remain arbitrarily detained and twelve death row inmates remain at imminent risk of execution. Amnesty International reports that the government continued to suppress the rights to freedom of expression, association and peaceful assembly, including through arbitrary detention and prosecutions.
short: Bahrain: arbitrary arrests, a death in custody and citizenship-stripping documented
